info.name: Budgeteer — Domain API (#11)
info.description:
Manual walk-through of the #11 domain endpoints: raw→domain ingest + the first product reads.

## Recommended Order

1. **Setup** — Quick Login, then Trigger Ingest (maps existing raw rows into bank_accounts/transactions and stamps balances)
2. **Accounts** — list, includeArchived, summary (default + explicit zone), then the 400/404 failure shapes
3. **Transactions** — default page, explicit paging, from/to (half-open [from,to)), accountId filter, then the 400 failure shapes

## Prerequisites
- App running with `dev` profile (`./scripts/dev.sh start`)
- Monzo OAuth completed earlier + at least one backfill/sync run (raw tables populated)
- Import `budgeteer-local.postman_environment.json` and select it
- Run `⚡ Quick Login` first to set auth cookies

## What This Tests
- POST /api/dev/monzo/ingest (dev trigger: ingest + balance refresh)
- GET /api/v1/accounts (+ includeArchived)
- GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}/summary (+ zone param, 400 bad zone, 404 unknown)
- GET /api/v1/transactions (paging, from/to, accountId filter, 400 validation shapes)

Note: unauthenticated requests to these endpoints return **403** (app-wide Spring Security default — no AuthenticationEntryPoint). To see it, clear the Postman cookie jar for localhost and re-send any request.

request.description: Log in without a magic link. Sets the auth cookies used by every request below.

exec: console.log("✅ Ingest pass complete — raw rows mapped to bank_accounts/transactions, balances stamped");

request.description: Dev-only: runs IngestService.ingestAll() then BalanceRefreshService.refreshAll() against whatever raw data the last sync/backfill left. Flow: monzo_* raw tables → MonzoIngestor (cursor on raw updated_at) → bank_accounts + transactions; then getBalance per account → balance snapshot columns.

exec: console.log("✅ " + json.data.length + " account(s). First: " + json.data[0].institutionName + " / " + json.data[0].accountType + " — balance " + json.data[0].balanceMinorUnits + " " + json.data[0].currency);
console.log("⚠️ No accounts — run Trigger Ingest first (and make sure a backfill has run)");

request.description: The user's active bank accounts, ordered display_order then created_at. Flow: AccountController → AccountService.listAccounts → AccountRepository.findActiveByUserId (user-scoped JPQL) → AccountResponse DTOs in the ApiResponse envelope. Balance fields are null until the first balance refresh.

exec: console.log("✅ " + json.data.length + " account(s) incl. archived: " + json.data.filter(a => a.archived).length + " archived");

request.description: Same as above but via findByUserId — archived (closed/disconnected) accounts included, flagged archived=true.

exec: console.log("✅ today in/out: " + json.data.today.inMinorUnits + "/" + json.data.today.outMinorUnits + " | week: " + json.data.thisWeek.inMinorUnits + "/" + json.data.thisWeek.outMinorUnits + " | month: " + json.data.monthToDate.inMinorUnits + "/" + json.data.monthToDate.outMinorUnits);

request.description: today / Monday-start week / month-to-date sums. Flow: AccountController (parses zone, defaults Europe/London) → AccountService.getSummary (404 if not the caller's account; computes window boundaries in the zone; floor = min(weekStart, monthStart)) → TransactionRepository.sumWindows (one native query, six FILTER sums, excludes excluded_from_analytics, includes PENDING) → out converted to positive magnitude.
Same sums with the day/week/month boundaries computed in New York time — 'today' can differ from the London answer around midnight.
ZoneId.of fails → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (currently via try/catch in the controller — flagged in PR review for native ZoneId binding instead).
Unknown (or another user's) account id → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. Never 403: existence is not confirmed.

exec: console.log("✅ " + json.data.totalElements + " transaction(s) total, " + json.data.items.length + " on this page (newest first)");
console.log("   newest: " + t.occurredAt + " " + t.amountMinorUnits + " " + t.currency + " " + (t.merchantName || t.description) + " [" + t.status + "]");

request.description: Newest-first page of the user's transactions. Flow: TransactionController (bean-validated page/size) → TransactionQueryService (defaults open-ended range EPOCH→far-future) → TransactionRepository.findFiltered (user-scoped JPQL, order in the query, unsorted Pageable) → PageResponse envelope.

exec: console.log("✅ " + json.data.totalElements + " transaction(s) in the window — remember [from, to) is half-open: a tx exactly at 'to' is EXCLUDED");

request.description: ISO-8601 Instants bind natively. Half-open [from, to): occurred_at >= from AND < to. The frontend owns timezone policy by choosing the instants.

exec: console.log("ℹ️ Filtering by an accountId you don't own returns an EMPTY PAGE, not 404 (user-scoped query, no info leak)");

request.description: Service-level validation: from must be strictly before to → 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
